summary: Iteration 34: Successfully tested Phase 20 features - For You personalized feed, interaction tracking, and expanded Settings page. All 30 backend API tests passed. Frontend UI verified with Playwright - Para Ti tab, reason badges, Settings page sections, PostCard features all working correctly.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created - used existing test posts
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 34 verified all Phase 20 features. Key data-testids: foryou-tab-btn, social-tab-btn, reels-tab-btn, cards-tab-btn, foryou-feed, refresh-foryou-btn, settings-page, toggle-*, setting-*, post-bookmark-btn, post-repost-btn, post-share-btn, hashtag-pill-*, mobile-bottom-nav, nav-*. Login returns 'access_token'. Para Ti tab only visible when logged in. For You posts include _for_you_reason field with values: following, hashtag_match, trending, discover. Settings preferences API uses GET and PUT on /api/settings/preferences.

for_you_feed_api.details: Returns personalized posts with _for_you_reason field, requires auth, supports pagination

interaction_tracking_api.details: Tracks view, click, expand, share, dwell interactions for recommendation improvement
